title: Behold Your God
edition: 4th ed. 2016 (Student Manual ISBN 978-1-59557-203-5; Teacher's Manual ISBN 978-1-59557-204-2, 2024 printing); revised and expanded by Jim Lord

publisher scope and sequence (lesson topics and life applications)

summary: A one-year, 35-lesson introduction to theology proper for high school: how a believer comes to know God, God's nature and attributes, the person and work of Christ, and the person and work of the Holy Spirit. Each lesson pairs doctrinal content with a devotional application, and the course closes on Christ's preeminence in every area of life.

toc.label: Unit 1
toc.title: The Knowledge of God
toc.covers: What it means to know God personally and the disciplines (Scripture, prayer, meditation, attention to providence, priorities) through which that knowledge grows.

children.label: Chapter 1
children.title: Laying the Foundation
children.covers: The doctrine of holiness, God's purpose in creation, and the need for faith (Hebrews 11:6).

children.label: Chapter 2
children.title: Getting a Right Focus
children.covers: Seeking God himself in his Word, avoiding unbalanced emphases, and recording what the Psalms reveal about God.

children.label: Chapter 3
children.title: Knowing God
children.covers: Knowing God through a growing personal relationship rather than secondhand report, through prayer and focused Bible study.

children.label: Chapter 4
children.title: Meditating on God in His Word
children.covers: Defining biblical meditation, its focus on God, and practical steps that also aid memory.

children.label: Chapter 5
children.title: Recognizing God's Providence
children.covers: Remembering and meditating on God's providential work, using biblical examples and students' own lives.

children.label: Chapter 6
children.title: The Priorities of One Who Knows God
children.covers: Weighing competing responsibilities and forming a life message that guides thought, speech and action.

children.label: Chapter 7
children.title: The Characteristics of One Who Knows God
children.covers: Traits of a person grounded in God's love and truth, balanced views on hard topics, and the distinction between God's essence and attributes.

toc.label: Unit 2
toc.title: The Nature of God
toc.covers: God as spirit and person, as one, and as triune.

children.label: Chapter 8
children.title: A Spirit and a Person
children.covers: God's nature as spirit and as personal, and worship in spirit and truth.

children.label: Chapter 9
children.title: God's Unity
children.covers: Old and New Testament teaching that there is one God, and the unity of believers that reflects it.

children.label: Chapter 10
children.title: The Trinity
children.covers: The doctrine of the Trinity across both testaments, arguments for and against it, comparison with non-Christian beliefs, and equal honor to Father, Son and Spirit.

toc.label: Unit 3
toc.title: The Attributes of God
toc.covers: God's natural and moral attributes, one per lesson, each with a personal application.

children.label: Chapter 11
children.title: His Omniscience
children.covers: God's perfect knowledge, the difference between natural and moral attributes, and the comfort and challenge of being fully known.

children.label: Chapter 12
children.title: His Omnipresence
children.covers: Biblical statements of God's presence everywhere and answers to common questions about it.

children.label: Chapter 13
children.title: His Omnipotence
children.covers: God's power, what God will not do, and trusting him in all circumstances.

children.label: Chapter 14
children.title: His Eternality
children.covers: God as eternal Creator and weighing life priorities in light of eternity.

children.label: Chapter 15
children.title: His Immutability
children.covers: God's unchangeableness applied to his person and his Word.

children.label: Chapter 16
children.title: His Holiness
children.covers: A two-part definition of holiness applied to God and to believers.

children.label: Chapter 17
children.title: His Justice and Righteousness
children.covers: God's justice, including the judgment of Canaan, and Christ as the standard of righteousness.

children.label: Chapter 18
children.title: His Mercy and Grace
children.covers: Distinguishing mercy from grace and forgiveness from reconciliation, with biblical models of forgiveness.

children.label: Chapter 19
children.title: His Love
children.covers: Defining godly love, common misconceptions, and love in harmony with God's other attributes.

children.label: Chapter 20
children.title: Knowing God: A Review
children.covers: Review of Unit 3 and of God's goodness shown in the gospel.

toc.label: Unit 4
toc.title: The History of Christ
toc.covers: Christ from eternity past through incarnation, atonement, resurrection and ascension.

children.label: Chapter 21
children.title: The Preciousness of Christ
children.covers: Scripture's statements of Christ's worth to believers and knowing God through his Son.

children.label: Chapter 22
children.title: The Pre-Existence of Christ
children.covers: Christ's existence before the incarnation, including John 1, and his identity as eternal God.

children.label: Chapter 23
children.title: The Incarnation of Christ
children.covers: The virgin birth and its implications, fulfilled prophecy, and the historical setting of Christ's coming.

children.label: Chapter 24
children.title: The Impeccability and Atonement of Christ
children.covers: Christ's sinlessness and the nature and results of his atoning death.

children.label: Chapter 25
children.title: The Resurrection of Christ
children.covers: The literal, bodily resurrection defined from Scripture and defended against false views.

children.label: Chapter 26
children.title: The Ascension of Christ
children.covers: Biblical accounts of the ascension, Christ's exaltation, and the hope of his return.

toc.label: Unit 5
toc.title: The Person of Christ
toc.covers: Christ's offices, deity, humanity and names.

children.label: Chapter 27
children.title: Christ as Prophet, Priest, and King
children.covers: The significance of Christ's three offices, past and present.

children.label: Chapter 28
children.title: Christ's Deity
children.covers: Scriptural evidence that Christ is God, including descriptions used only of God.

children.label: Chapter 29
children.title: Christ's Humanity
children.covers: Christ's human heritage and nature, and historic heresies about it; Christ as a sympathetic Savior.

children.label: Chapter 30
children.title: Christ's Names
children.covers: The names and titles of Jesus in Scripture, especially the expectations behind 'Messiah'.

toc.label: Unit 6
toc.title: The Holy Spirit
toc.covers: The person and work of the Spirit, ending with Christ's first claim on the believer.

children.label: Chapter 31
children.title: Who the Holy Spirit Is
children.covers: The Spirit's personhood and deity, compared with the other persons of the Trinity.

children.label: Chapter 32
children.title: The Creative Work of the Spirit
children.covers: The Spirit's work in creation and in the inspiration and revelation of Scripture.

children.label: Chapter 33
children.title: The Holy Spirit's Work in Salvation
children.covers: The Spirit's role in bringing people to new life.

children.label: Chapter 34
children.title: The Holy Spirit's Work in Sanctification
children.covers: The Spirit's ongoing work in believers and walking with the Spirit toward holiness.

children.label: Chapter 35
children.title: The First-Claim Principle
children.covers: Christ's preeminence applied to every area of life.

notes: Titles follow the Teacher's Manual contents page; the publisher's scope and sequence uses lesson topics that match them. The scope-and-sequence PDF's columns are misaligned for Lessons 21-34, so those 'covers' lines lean on the lesson titles and topic column, not on the activity lists. The publisher recommends grades 9-11; this school places it in grade 11. Open Library's series catalog gives a subtitle, 'Magnify His Majesty', which does not appear on the current product page.
